content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation (including short-term contract) initially for three years unless specified otherwise under individual posts PPS: deputation including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation ordinarily not to exceed four years; other posts three years Terms governed by DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time Selected candidates will not be relieved before the expiry of the deputation tenure

content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format (Annexure-II) with passport size photograph Attested copies of ACR/APAR dossiers for the preceding five years Valid Vigilance Clearance Certificate Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority, countersigned with seal Latest salary slip if the organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MoEF&CC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-II, Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae) with a passport size photograph pasted. Forward it through the proper channel with the recommendation of the parent office. Enclose attested copies of ACR/APAR dossiers for the preceding five years and a valid Vigilance Clearance Certificate. Send it to the Deputy Director General of Forests (Central), Regional Office, Bhopal, so that it reaches within 45 days of publication in the Employment News. Make sure it reaches by 25 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications without parent office recommendation, incomplete applications, or those received after the due date without ACR/APAR dossiers/Vigilance Clearance will be summarily rejected Departmental Private Secretary in Level 7 with seven years' regular service in the Regional Office will be considered with outsiders for PPS; if selected, it is treated as promotion

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MoEF&CC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MoEF&CC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Principal Private Secretary (PPS), 1 Section Officer (SO), 1 Junior Translator, 1 Assistant, 1 Upper Division Clerk (UDC).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MoEF&CC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae) of this PDF) and send it to Deputy Director General of Forests (Central), Regional Office, Bhopal, Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change, Kendriya Paryavaran Bhavan, Link Road No.3, E-5, Ravi Shankar Nagar, Arera Colony, Bhopal - 462016 (M.P.), by through proper channel, to reach by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,08,700 ) for Principal Private Secretary (PPS), Level 7 (Rs. 44,900 - 1,42,400 ) for Section Officer (SO), Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400 ) for Junior Translator, Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400 ) for Assistant, Level 4 (Rs. 25,500 - 81,100 ) for Upper Division Clerk (UDC).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, PSUs, Universities, Recognized Research Institutions or Statutory/Autonomous Organizations holding analogous posts or with the prescribed regular service; Bachelor's Degree for SO and Assistant (SO also 2 years' accounts and administration experience); Master's degree with Hindi/English and translation diploma or 2 years' translation experience for Junior Translator. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officials of Central/State Governments, UTs, PSUs, Universities, Recognized Research Institutions or Statutory/Autonomous Organizations may apply. Principal Private Secretary: open to officers holding the post of Stenographer. Applicants should be able to be relieved immediately upon selection.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation. Deputationists are not eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Information in the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents on Essential Qualification/Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (including short-term contract) initially for three years unless specified otherwise under individual posts. PPS: deputation including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation ordinarily not to exceed four years; other posts three years. Terms governed by DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time.
